transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been troubling you or what brings you in today?

Well... I suppose it's just that I've been spending rather a lot of my time on certain things at home. Just... opening the same folders and drawers, mostly. And some labeled boxes I have. 

I just... I feel the need to make sure my important papers and keepsakes are exactly where I left them. I end up checking them again and again... even if I just looked a few minutes before. It's... well, it's taking up far too much of my day.
Do you feel anxious or upset if you're not able to check your folders, drawers, or boxes for a while?

Well... I don't know about upset. I just... as I was saying, I just find myself having to open them again. The same ones, over and over. 

If I try to sit down and ignore it, I just... I end up going back to make sure the papers are still there. Even if I just checked a few minutes ago. I suppose I don't really wait long enough to find out how I'd feel if I didn't. I just do it.
Do you have certain thoughts or ideas that keep coming into your mind, maybe even against your will, that make you feel like you have to check those folders or drawers again?

I suppose... yes. It's just... well, a thought will keep needling me. Even when I know better. 

I'll just suddenly worry that I might have... oh, thrown away my husband's old tax papers by mistake. Or perhaps that I put a family recipe in the wrong box. It's... I can't seem to let it pass. If I don't go look, I just feel like I've done something terribly careless. So I check. That's all.
Do these thoughts that make you check the folders or drawers cause you a lot of distress, or do you find them disturbing and try to ignore or suppress them?

Well... I don't know about distress. That sounds rather dramatic. They're just... bothersome, I suppose. 

I wouldn't call them disturbing. And I don't really try to ignore them or push them away. As I said... I just get up and check the boxes. It's simply what I do.
When you check the folders or drawers, do you feel that not doing so would lead to something bad happening, like losing important items or making a mistake you can't undo?

Well... yes, I suppose. Losing them, or making a mistake. But really, the reason I finally came in to see you is just... well, because I spend far too much of my day doing it. 

I just find myself opening the same folders and drawers... those labeled boxes, again and again. Just to make sure the important papers and keepsakes are right where I left them. Even when I just checked a few minutes before. It just... it takes up so much of my time now.
When you check the folders or drawers, do you feel that you must do it a certain number of times, or in a specific way, to make sure nothing bad happens or to ease your worry?

No... I don't think so. I don't count how many times I do it, or go about it in any special order, if that's what you mean. 

I just... look inside. Until I see the papers are there. That's all.

Have you noticed any other kinds of thoughts or worries that keep coming into your mind, even if they’re not about losing things or making mistakes, that you also find bothersome or hard to let go of?
No, I... I can't say that I have. It's really just the boxes. I don't... I don't have other worries like that. Just the checking.

When you check your folders or boxes, do you feel that you must perform the checking in a specific way or that you have to do it over and over until it feels 'just right' to avoid something bad happening?

I... well, I thought I just mentioned... no, not really. There isn't a special way I do it. 

I just... look. Until I see that they haven't been moved. I don't know about it feeling 'just right' or anything like that. I just look inside. That's all.
When you check the folders or boxes, does it help reduce a feeling of anxiety or discomfort, even if just temporarily?

I suppose it does. For a minute or two. But... well, that is why I finally came in to see someone. 

Because I spend far too much of my day doing it. Opening those same folders and drawers... the labeled boxes. Over and over. I just have to make sure the important papers and my keepsakes are where I left them. Even when I know I just checked them a few minutes before. 

It's... it's just taking up too much of my day.

Do you ever have sudden, unwanted thoughts that come into your mind about something bad happening, like accidentally throwing something away or making a mistake, even when there’s no real reason to think that would happen?

Well... yes, I suppose so. Sometimes. 

I'll just be sitting there, and... even when I know better, a thought will just start needling me. That maybe I accidentally threw away my late husband's old tax papers. Or... or that I put one of my mother's family recipes in the wrong box. 

It's silly, I know. But the thought just gets stuck. And I can't seem to let it pass without feeling like I've done something terribly careless. So I just... I have to go look.
